_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Found the deals available at this address.

description: Check which fibre and broadband deals are available at a UK postcode (or exact address via UPRN/UDPRN) using fibrecompare.com. Returns providers, download speeds, monthly prices, contract lengths, key features and a sign-up link for each deal. Optionally filter by minimum speed, maximum price, provider or contract length.

address.description: House number/name and optionally street, e.g. '12', 'Flat 3, 12', 'Rose Cottage'. If it matches one premises at the postcode the check is done at address level in this same call.

address_key.description: An address_key from a previous result's addresses list. Runs the check for that exact premises.

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return (default 5). The full list is always available at view_more_url.

max_contract_months.description: Only return deals with a contract of at most this many months (0 = rolling/no contract).

max_monthly_cost_gbp.description: Only return deals costing at most this much per month in GBP.

min_download_mbps.description: Only return deals whose average download speed is at least this many Mbps (e.g. 100, 500, 900).

postcode.description: UK postcode to check, e.g. 'SW1A 1AA'. Spacing and case do not matter.

provider.description: Only return deals from providers whose name contains this text, e.g. 'BT', 'Hyperoptic'.

sort.description: Ordering: 'recommended' (default; fibrecompare.com's editorial ranking), 'value' (cheapest effective monthly cost), 'price' (cheapest headline monthly cost), 'speed' (fastest first) or 'site' (backend order).

udprn.description: Royal Mail Unique Delivery Point Reference Number, if known and no UPRN is available.

uprn.description: Unique Property Reference Number for the exact premises, if known. Gives an address-level rather than postcode-level answer.

visitor_id.description: The visitor_id from a previous result in this conversation. Reuse it so checks and deal clicks are attributed to the same visit. Omit on the first call.

name: check_fibre_availability

addresses.description: For postcode-level results: the premises at this postcode. Pass one's address_key back to get an exact-address check.

cost_basis.description: Whether the cost figures come from fibrecompare's computed pricing (models price rises) or are a local estimate.

view_more_url.description: fibrecompare.com results page for this address, listing every available deal.

visitor_id.description: Pass back as visitor_id on later calls in this conversation.

title: Check fibre broadband availability
